$comment: IL2CPP memory offsets for Among Us (Steam). All numeric values are hex strings. Edit this file to fix 'No player list found' after a game patch – no recompilation needed.

gameData.$comment: RVA of the static pointer that holds the address of the static-field storage for GameData. Find with: IL2CPP dumper → GameData$$get_Instance → first MOV RAX,[RIP+x] → compute RVA.

localPlayer.$comment: RVA of the static pointer for PlayerControl.LocalPlayer.

playerList.$comment: Offsets within the GameData instance and the backing Il2CppList.

playerInfo.$comment: Field offsets within a PlayerInfo (NetworkedPlayerInfo) instance.

playerControl.$comment: Field offsets within a PlayerControl instance.

signatures.$comment: Optional AOB (array-of-bytes) patterns used by OffsetScanner to auto-detect the static RVAs above when the hardcoded offsets stop working. '??' is a wildcard byte. ripDisplacement is the byte index of the 4-byte RIP-relative displacement inside the matched instruction; instrSize is the full instruction length used to compute the target address.
